description:
How much can be borrowed against one NFT on GONDI right now,
whoever holds it: the largest loan offer it can take (net principal,
APR, duration, origination fee, loan-to-floor and expiry) and the
cheapest-APR offer when that is another one, with gondi_url, the NFT's
page where its owner borrows. Answers "how much can I borrow against
X #N". To weigh selling the NFT against borrowing on it, call
get_nft_market too and follow the lending guide's "sell or borrow"
paragraph. A wrapped CryptoPunk is quoted on the offers of its
CryptoPunk, which it borrows on. It takes a collection slug and a
token id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

currency.description: Only offers in this principal currency; any if unset.
currency.title: Currency

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: get_borrow_quote

BorrowingOffer.description: The loan offer a borrower can take on the NFT now.

expires_at.description: When the offer stops being takeable.
expires_at.title: Expires At

loan_to_floor_percent.description: The net principal as a share of the collection floor, both in USD; null without a floor or a rate.
loan_to_floor_percent.title: Loan To Floor Percent

net_principal.description: What the borrower receives: the principal the lender can fund now, less the origination fee.
net_principal.title: Net Principal

net_principal_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
net_principal_usd.title: Net Principal Usd

offer_type.description: Made on every NFT of the collection, on this NFT alone, or on a chosen set of NFTs it belongs to.
offer_type.title: Offer Type

BorrowingOffer.title: BorrowingOffer

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

active_loan_status.description: The status of the open loan the NFT is already collateral in, which a new loan cannot take until it ends; null when it is in none.
active_loan_status.title: Active Loan Status

cheapest_apr_offer.description: The lowest-APR offer a lender can still fund on the NFT, the larger first among equal rates; null when it is the largest offer itself or there is none.

floor_price.description: The collection's floor; null when nothing is listed.

largest_offer.description: The most anyone holding the NFT can borrow against it now, the offer GONDI's Borrow page shows for it; null when no lender can fund a loan on it.

title: Borrow quote
